title: How to survive a zombie apocalypse
idea: Survive it (realistic, teaches real steps): the outbreak starts on a normal morning; five friends survive a week in a fifth-floor flat by six real survival steps, acted on screen and named by the narrator
format: series: Survive it (title spoken at 0.0, day HUD, STEP cards, one cause-and-effect chain, realistic, stands alone)

visible.why: P01: a normal morning on the sofa; the TV news shows a hospital with blocked doors
STAY INDOORS on the TV, every face goes still
P02: below, a car in a lamp post, people running, the first one caught
the five at the railing, every phone buzzing with the same alert
the Gunslinger shrugs: 'It's just the flu.' Then a bang on their own door
P03: the door splinters, a zombie arm through the plank; the wardrobe goes against it, the table behind, chairs
a siren outside: the hands let go; the barricade holds the door, not their bodies
P04: shoes off, a finger on the lips; the whole street flows to the noise
P05: the tap runs full: the tub, every pot, every bottle is filled while there still is water
P06: day 3, the tap is dry; they drink from the tub they filled, one cup each, the tally marks on the wall
P07: the last tin is empty on the floor; Phoenix's stomach growls
the door bulges with silhouettes; staying means starving and the door will go
P08: Spud throws the ringing alarm clock far up the street, the ladder bridge laid beside him
every head turns to the clock, the crowd shuffles away from the shop
P09: the Gunslinger stuffs a sack far too heavy; Spud with a small pack: only what you can run with
P10: he crawls back with the huge sack on his back; one tin slips out and falls
the tin hits the police car, the alarm; hundreds of faces turn straight up
Spud: 'Drop it!' The sack falls; they crawl on light
P11: the door bursts; Spud and the Wizard hold the narrow hall, forearms taped, one zombie at a time; Phoenix waves the others to the ladder
all five crawl over the ladder to the shop roof; the zombies reach the balcony behind them
P12: day 7, all five alive on the roof with rainwater and one tin; the old balcony full of zombies across the street
